questions.question: Distinguish between economic carrying capacity and physical carrying capacity . (2 × 5 = 10)
questions.solution_html:
• CO4: Economic carrying capacity and physical carrying capacity.
  • The extent to which tourism support local economies without leading to over dependence
  • or inflation of local goods and services is called economic carrying capacity.
  • Physical carrying capacity is the maximum number of tourists that can physically
  • accommodate at a time in a destination.

questions.question: Examine the various alternative tourism with appropriate examples. [1x15 = 15]
questions.solution_html:
• Examine the various alternative tourism with appropriate examples. /[CO4]
  • Alternative tourism refers to forms of travel that differ from conventional mass tourism. It focuses on
  • sustainable, authentic, and environmentally or culturally sensitive experiences, often promoting local
  • development and minimizing negative impacts.
  • • Ecotourism. Eg: Gavi Ecotourism in Kerala, Periyar Tiger Reserve.
  • • Adventure Tourism. Eg: River rafting in Rishikesh, trekking in Himachal Pradesh.
  • • Cultural Tourism. Eg: Visiting forts and palaces in Rajasthan, attending Theyyamperformances
  • • Rural Tourism. Eg: Kumbalangi Model Village in Kerala.
  • • Wildlife Tourism. Eg: Safari tours in Kaziranga National Park or Bandipur Tiger Reserve.
  • • Medical Tourism. Eg: Kerala’s Ayurveda treatments; medical hospitals attracting international
  • patients to Chennai etc
